result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but the top-right profile/avatar control renders as an empty gray circle with only a notification dot, which looks broken. A couple of minor contrast and consistency issues were also found in the search field and favorite buttons.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right header appears empty: a plain light-gray circle with a small red dot and no avatar image, user initials, or icon. It reads as a failed image load or missing glyph rather than an intentional control.
issues.suggestion: Render a fallback avatar (user photo, initials, or a person/cart icon) inside the circle, and ensure the notification badge is positioned on the corner of a visible icon rather than floating in an empty shape.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and the magnifier icon are very light gray on a light gray fill, giving low contrast that may fail WCAG 1.4.11/1.4.3 for readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text and icon (e.g., #6B7280 or darker) so they reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent between cards: the ramen card shows a bare white heart outline directly on the photo, while the pizza card shows the heart inside a dark translucent circular background. The bare version has poor contrast against lighter image areas.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark scrim/circular container behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards for consistent styling and reliable contrast.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, with no rating, cuisine tag, or promo badge, while 'Popular right now' cards show rating and cuisine. The inconsistency makes the first row look like partially loaded content.
issues.suggestion: Either add a consistent secondary metadata line (rating/cuisine) to the fastest cards or intentionally differentiate the card layouts with a clear visual rationale.
